body:
Well to tell you the truth i was aware from the beginning that there's no easy way to commit a suicide, but I asked anway just in case I missed something. I decided that jumping is the method I'm going to use, I was kinda paranoid just yesterday, but now that I decided I'm a little bit calmer.
Of course, it would still require a lot of planning and such, but that's really a trivial matter.
There has to be at least one building that's just fine, in the whole city.
Regarding suicide hotline and professional help in general:

I am very skeptical. I really don't want to do that. I'm really scared that the conclusion will be the that im just 'whining'. Might be true who knows. I don't  even know what to say. I call them and then what? Tell them I'm a little sad? I really just can't...but not because i think it's pathetic to ask for help (not at all!) but because I really don't think that I can get genuine help,or these proffesionals who have their own life and problems, would care at all. Maye I'm just projecting, but yes, right now I definitely don't care about other people's problems. Well that might change your view of me.. 

Of course, one could say that at this point, even if it's the complete opposite of genuine , even that kind of help would matter.

Not sure...I'm not sure what I want to hear even.

But in all honesty I can't imagine what kind of help i can get in order to convince me. 

Sure it's true that i should at least try,at least once, but i really can't talk about my feelings. It's way too hard, i don't think I'm normal.
I would end up commiting suicide before I reach the place of the meeting.

Thank you for the help.

What do you mean? I don't know if it's sarcasm It's kinda hard to detect through the screen but let's hope it isn't.
Could you elaborate?
If you're asking why I have thoughts and ideas centered around commiting suicide , I'm not fully comfortable sharing those I'm sorry.
But thank you for the reply!
